announcements.name: Cosmos DB semantic re-ranking
announcements.shortDescription: Among several Cosmos DB announcements that week, highlighted as popular with the community
announcements.longDescription: Among several Cosmos DB announcements made that week, semantic re-ranking was highlighted as one that is very popular and well-liked by the Cosmos DB community. It is part of Microsoft's broader push to give every Azure database integrated vector support for rich searching, tightly integrated with tools like Foundry. Cosmos DB is described as a NoSQL database with transactional intent that PepsiCo has used in one of its solutions.

announcements.name: Azure SQL Database / Hyperscale GitHub Copilot integration
announcements.shortDescription: Deeper integration with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code to improve the Azure SQL developer experience
announcements.longDescription: Azure SQL Database, including Hyperscale, had several announcements that week centered on deep integrations with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code. These integrations are intended to give developers a better experience working with Azure SQL. Azure SQL Hyperscale is based on SQL Server and is among the relational databases PepsiCo uses.

announcements.name: CAM 360 agentic system
announcements.shortDescription: PepsiCo's six-agent system (orchestrator, data analyst, tactic, tracking, best-practices, and debrief agents) that prepares KAMs for customer meetings
announcements.longDescription: CAM 360 is PepsiCo's agentic system that prepares key account managers (KAMs) for customer meetings, illustrated through the example of a KAM named Priya preparing for a meeting with a large retail customer. Instead of manually combing through many systems, reports, emails, and documents, she uses CAM 360, which provides a team of six agents: an orchestrator that acts as a smart project manager, a data analyst agent that crunches the numbers, a tactic agent that captures account personas and strategies, a tracking agent that manages the account lifecycle, a best-practices agent that ensures PepsiCo's success runbook is followed, and a live conversational debrief agent that fills knowledge gaps by asking the user questions and capturing the answers. Together these agents give every KAM the equivalent of a six-person support team.
